name: Greece Town Center
summary: Greece Town Center is an AAA-rated retail and office plaza located at the high-traffic corner of Mitchell and West Ridge Road, with 90,000 cars passing daily. Strategically positioned near Greece Ridge Mall and Unity Hospital, this well-managed center offers excellent visibility and accessibility for businesses.
demographics: Greece Town Center serves the northwest Rochester suburban market, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the Greece area. The center benefits from its proximity to Greece Ridge Mall and Unity Hospital, drawing a diverse mix of shoppers including healthcare workers, retail employees, and local residents. With 90,000 cars passing daily on West Ridge Road, the trade area captures both convenience-oriented shoppers and commuters seeking accessible retail and office services.
description: Greece Town Center is a premier AAA-rated retail plaza strategically positioned at the corner of Mitchell and West Ridge Road in Rochester, New York. This well-established shopping center benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility, with an impressive 90,000 vehicles passing by daily, making it one of the most trafficked retail corridors in the Greece area. The center offers both retail and office space opportunities, featuring two means of egress for optimal traffic flow and customer convenience. Its prime location centers around major anchors including Greece Ridge Mall and Unity Hospital, creating a robust ecosystem of retail activity and professional services. Managed by Alloco Real Estate Management, a respected local property management company with a diverse portfolio throughout the Rochester region, Greece Town Center provides businesses with a stable, high-traffic environment ideal for both retail operations and professional office tenants.
